title: 3. Applications of Machine Learning
description: Discover how ML powers vision, speech, natural language processing, recommenders, fraud detection, and self-driving cars.

blocks.content:
### Real-World ML Applications

Machine learning powers essential technology we interact with every single day:

- **Computer Vision & Speech Recognition**: Face ID phone unlock, auto-captions on YouTube, Siri/Alexa voice transcription.
- **Natural Language Processing (NLP)**: Smart auto-complete, real-time Google Translate, sentiment analysis on customer reviews, and conversational AI chatbots.
- **Recommender Systems**:
  - *Content-Based Filtering*: Recommending movies with similar genres/tags to what you already watched.
  - *Collaborative Filtering*: Recommending items liked by users with similar viewing history.
- **Fraud Detection**: Flagging anomalous credit card transactions in real-time.
- **Autonomous Vehicles**: Fusing camera, lidar, and radar sensors to navigate streets safely.

blocks.question: If Spotify recommends songs to you because users with listening habits similar to yours liked those songs, what system is it using?
blocks.explanation: Collaborative filtering makes recommendations based on the preferences of similar users.
